name: Galleonaire
description: Take on Galleonaire on iPhone and Apple Watch. Answer fifteen increasingly difficult questions for a fictional million-galleon prize. Explore 600 questions about Harry Potter books, films and the wider wizarding world, with forty questions at every prize level. Correct answers move straight to the next question, with no confirmation or Next Question button. Use Fifty-Fifty, Ask the Audience and Swap Question, protect guaranteed prizes, or walk away with your winnings. Enjoy original magical-library artwork, dramatic game-over music and a celebratory million-galleon fanfare. Both devices support independent offline games, a saved highest prize, native VoiceOver controls, adjustable original music, sound effects and haptics. Every fresh launch opens the main menu without restoring an unfinished game. Independent fan-made quiz, not affiliated with or endorsed by the authors, publishers or film studios referenced. Galleons are fictional points with no monetary value. No advertising or analytics.
whatToTest:
WHAT IS NEW
- 150 new questions: ten at every prize level, for 600 in total. Recent-question history reduces early repeats.
- Clearer book and film references, including the Dobby/Neville Gillyweed distinction.
- VoiceOver moves to the new question after a correct answer. The previous answer and explanation have their own separate item above it.
- Answers are reshuffled for every question. The correct A/B/C/D position does not repeat on consecutive draws, including swaps and new games.
- Original enchanted-library artwork, framed question cards and a brief green correct/red incorrect edge glow. There is no repeated strobe; Reduce Motion or Dim Flashing Lights suppresses the animated glow. Text and symbols still identify the result.

PLEASE TEST
1. With VoiceOver on, answer several questions correctly. It should read the new question first, without announcing a random answer. Swipe left to read the previous explanation separately, then swipe right back to the question and answers. Check this on both iPhone and Apple Watch.
2. Play, swap and restart repeatedly. Check that all four answer positions are used and that scoring, Fifty-Fifty and audience percentages follow the displayed answers.
3. Report any repeated question, ambiguous wording or factual error with the complete question and its source. Check book-versus-film distinctions carefully.
4. Check artwork, green/red result feedback, contrast and large text. Repeat with Reduce Motion and Dim Flashing Lights enabled; there should be no animated result glow.
5. Test wins, losses, Walk Away, Main Menu, both volume sliders, sound previews and phone/Watch settings sync. A fresh launch should retain records and settings but start at the menu.

Please include device, OS version and reproduction steps. Physical VoiceOver testing is especially valuable for this update.
reviewNotes: No account, password, purchase, advertising or external service is needed to play. Start with New Game. The Watch app is embedded in the iPhone build and is playable independently. In-game galleons are fictional score points, not money, gambling or redeemable prizes. The app does not request Health, contacts, location, microphone or tracking access. Review both visual and native VoiceOver gameplay. The expanded question bank contains independently written trivia with source notes. Artwork and audio are original and the app makes no claim of official franchise affiliation.
